sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Acrobatics, Aqua Step, Drum Beating, Fiery Dance, Fire Lash, First Impression, Flower Trick, Fly, Make It Rain, Pay Day, Petal Dance, Power Whip, Revelation Dance, and Vine Whip: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Fighting-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Special Defense.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Jungle Beat: 1.5× power for sound-based moves.
Punk Rock: 1.5× power for sound-based moves.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Attack +1 and gains a special effect.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
